prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 16:9 photographic supporting image for an AI literacy course for 16-year-olds. Mature candid editorial photography, natural light, believable anatomy and ordinary student clothing, navy/teal and warm cream tones. Scene: three high-school-age students collaborate on a history class group project at a library table. One points to a simple timeline on a printed page, another offers a sticky note, the third considers and revises a project outline. Show the specific actions of exchanging ideas, asking questions and improving work together. A few open history books and a laptop with a simple presentation outline, no prominent text beyond 'History Project'. No electronics schematics. Warm realistic school library, coherent single scene, landscape wide framing with all important hands/faces comfortably inside the central 90% for a subtle video push. No collage, cartoon, logo, watermark, gibberish labels, large caption or decorative border.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 16:9 supporting photo-like image for an AI literacy course for 16-year-olds. Mature natural candid editorial photography, warm window light, navy/teal and cream colors, realistic anatomy and ordinary casual clothing. A high-school-age student at a neighborhood kitchen table tutors a younger school-age child in basic math. The teen points encouragingly at a simple number-line drawing on paper while the younger student works through it with a pencil. Make the teaching action clear, focus on both students and the worksheet, comfortable believable home setting, ordinary neat table. No AI interface needed; this illustrates a student's existing skill that could become a summer tutoring business. Minimal incidental text, no large captions, logos, watermarks, collage, cartoon or garbled visible writing. Landscape full bleed; important faces and hands within central 90% safe area for a small push-in.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 16:9 supporting photo-like image for an AI literacy course for 16-year-olds. Mature natural candid editorial photography with real textures, warm afternoon daylight, navy/teal and cream accents, natural proportions, ordinary casual clothing. Show a high-school-age student planning a small neighborhood lawn-mowing service at a patio table beside a suburban lawn. The student reviews a simple neighborhood street map and notes beside an open laptop showing a sparse AI conversation and a plan; a bicycle leans nearby and a push lawn mower rests on the grass in the background. The action must be planning a workable nearby service, not simply posing or actively mowing. Only large readable text on laptop: 'Lawn service plan' with three short items 'Nearby homes', 'Weekday afternoons', 'Price by lawn size'. No other legible paragraphs, brands, logo, watermark, cartoon, collage or captions. Landscape full bleed, key face, hands, laptop and bicycle/mower visible within central 90% safe area for a restrained push-in.
